# The checks that must pass before a merge into main, as GitHub names the jobs of a pull request
# (docs/04 §6). The ruleset of main requires these (docs/04 §7.1), and bin/check-release-gates.py
# refuses a release while one of them is not required. tests/Release/test_release_gates.py
# checks that every line names a job of ci.yml or integration.yml, so a renamed job is renamed
# here in the same pull request. One check per line; a line that starts with # is a comment.

# ci.yml
Coding standards
JavaScript (ESLint)
Static analysis
Plugin Check on the package
Translation template (POT)
Commits are signed off
Unit tests (PHP 8.3)
Unit tests (PHP 8.4)
Unit tests (PHP 8.5)
Unit tests (PHP 8.6)
Unit tests (PHP 8.3, zstd)
Database dump and restore (MySQL 8.4)
Database dump and restore (MariaDB 11.4)
Mutation testing (Crypto, Format, Forget, database import)
Mutation testing (file apply planner)
Mutation testing (file restore)
Mutation testing (file apply jobs)
Mutation testing (ZIP downloads)
